$comment: Single source of truth for the component catalog. The docs site reads this for its index and route params; scripts/build-registry.mjs turns it into shadcn-installable JSON in public/r/.

components.title: Agent Handoff
components.description: Control passing from one agent to another, with the reason.

components.title: Agent Status
components.description: Indicator for what the agent is doing right now.

components.title: Approval
components.description: Human-in-the-loop gate with risk levels and a two-press confirm.

components.title: Artifact
components.description: A document the agent produced, with its revision history.

components.title: Attachment
components.description: File chips with upload state and per file remove buttons.

components.title: Checkpoint
components.description: A point in the run you can rewind to, with a confirm because it discards work.

components.title: Citation
components.description: Inline source reference with an expandable card.

components.title: Code Block
components.description: Code with a copy button that reports success and failure.

components.title: Composer
components.description: Prompt input that auto-resizes and becomes a stop button mid-run.

components.title: Context List
components.description: What the agent can see, with per item cost and a budget warning.

components.title: Diff
components.description: Streaming-aware line diff.

components.title: Empty State
components.description: The screen before there is anything to show yet.

components.title: Feedback
components.description: Thumbs up or down on a single response, one active at a time.

components.title: Log Stream
components.description: Process output with ANSI colour and autoscroll that releases when you scroll away.

components.title: One Piece Background
components.description: Animated ocean sunset background with layered waves and atmospheric effects.

components.title: Reasoning
components.description: Collapsible model reasoning that folds away once settled.

components.title: Retry After
components.description: A rate limit countdown that gates retry until it clears.

components.title: Run Controls
components.description: Pause, resume, step, and stop, with only the legal actions shown.

components.title: Run Error
components.description: A failed run, with the trace collapsed and a retry beside it.

components.title: Run Timeline
components.description: Ordered trace of agent steps.

components.title: Streaming Text
components.description: Model output that announces one sentence at a time.

components.title: Suggestions
components.description: Prompt chips that cost one tab stop, not one per chip.

components.title: Task List
components.description: The agent's plan, with aggregate progress.

components.title: Tool Call
components.description: Tool invocation rendered as an accessible disclosure.

components.title: Tool Permission
components.description: Standing per tool grants with scope and revoke.

components.title: Usage Meter
components.description: Token, cost, and context-window readout.
